name: 1789 Capital
summary: A Palm Beach venture firm founded in October 2022 by Omeed Malik, Rebekah Mercer and Chris Buskirk, members of the Rockbridge Network, to build a "parallel economy" of America First businesses. Donald Trump Jr. joined as a partner after the 2024 election. Its assets grew from about $200 million to $3.5 billion in roughly a year, and companies it backs received more than $735 million in federal contracts and loans in the second Trump administration, drawing conflict-of-interest criticism.
